enunciado: Write isLeapYear(year) (divisible by 4 and not by 100, or divisible by 400) and show it for 1900, 2000, 2024 and 2026. Then count the leap years between 1901 and 2000.
objetivos: Translate a natural-language rule into a boolean expression
pistas: Return the boolean expression directly, without an if.
Use parentheses to make the combination of && and || clear.
